name: Pet cremation & aftercare for independent Chicago vet clinics (route + trade cremation, own retort from month 12)
summary: Customers = independent veterinary clinics on a weekly freezer-pickup route in Chicago/inner Cook. Months 1-11 cremation is bought from a trade crematory; an owned multi-chamber retort in a leased industrial unit is installed in month 12 (capex + rent + operator). Revenue = wholesale per-pet fees billed monthly to clinics (clinics mark up to owners). Direct-to-family and home-euthanasia partner cases are excluded (upside).
evidence_notes: Clinic universe: 115 licensed veterinary-hospital locations in the City of Chicago; ~35 held by national/venture groups by licence-holder name, plus local multi-site groups [A, DE-S001]. Illinois: 22% of vet establishments and 41% of receipts sit in 500+-employee firms [C, DE-S002].

Main incumbent: Gateway Services' Trusted Journey brand has 6 Illinois sites incl. Hinsdale Animal Cemetery (Willowbrook), Paw Print Gardens (West Chicago) and Pets At Peace (Hampshire), with barcode chain-of-custody (Paws e-Track, 20+ scans) [B, DE-S003; C, DE-S004]. The planned tracking wedge is already the incumbent standard.

Retail anchors: Chicago private cremation from $130 (cat) / $160 (small dog) [B, DE-S015]; CodaPet Chicago cremation $150-$505 [B, DE-S014]; downstate Deiters individual $200-$300, group $50-$180, vet transfer $95 [B, C8-S014; located Washington IL, DE-S041]. Clinic WHOLESALE prices and trade-cremation fees are MISSING; drivers use E values anchored ~40-55% below retail.
Pets per clinic per month MISSING; statute treats >5 referrals per average month as 'regular' referring (815 ILCS 318) [A, C8-S006]; base uses 10 (E).

Retort cost: one federal transaction $95,047 for a Matthews Power Pak I system + accessories (2018) [A, DE-S011]; seller ranges new $35k-$100k+, used $2k-$35k [D, DE-S012]. Installed cost incl. stack/gas/freight modeled $80k-$160k (E).

Air permit: no Illinois permit exemption for incinerators/crematories (35 IAC 201.146) and ROSS registration excludes incinerator systems (35 IAC 201.175) [A, DE-S005, DE-S006] -> assume IEPA construction + operating permit; local special use typical (Huntley approved a pet crematory SUP in ~7 months; Mokena denied a crematorium SUP) [C, DE-S007, DE-S008].
Constant gross margin is a simplification: months 1-11 (trade cremation) would run ~30 points lower on small revenue; error on year-1 operating profit is roughly $5-15k.
Owner draw $4,000/mo from month 13 (comparability); operating profit is before owner compensation.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Van, freezer, insurance, trade-crematory agreement and 815 ILCS 318 written explanation before first clinic (no state licence needed [A, C8-S006])
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified clinic conversations; ~80 non-consolidator Chicago licences [A, DE-S001] plus inner-suburb clinics (Illinois 1,137 vet establishments [C, DE-S002])
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Assumed share of conversations that agree to a priced trial
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Switching from Gateway/Trusted Journey (barcode tracking, local cemeteries) or local crematories requires a service failure or price gap [B, DE-S003]
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Vet-to-vet and home-euthanasia-vet word of mouth (CodaPet/Lap of Love channel [B, DE-S014; C, DE-S042])
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Losses from service failures and from consolidator acquisitions of independents (41% of IL vet receipts already in 500+ firms [C, DE-S002])
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Pets/clinic/month 7/10/12.5 (E; statutory 'regular' threshold >5 [A, C8-S006]) x blended wholesale ~$78.50 (55% private at $110, 45% communal at $40; E, ~40-55% below Chicago retail $130-$505 [B, DE-S014, DE-S015]) + $50-$70 merchandise/upgrades
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Own retort: gas+maintenance ~$12/pet, bags/ID tags/basic urns ~$8/pet, merchandise COGS, overflow trade cremation for >70-lb pets and downtime; months 1-11 trade cremation (fee MISSING, ~$46.50/pet E) blended in
drivers.variable_opex_pct_revenue__source: Van fuel/maintenance on weekly route + card/ACH fees
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Lunch-and-learns, printed statutory explanations, sample urns, travel
